verdict.rationale: Pulumi offers AI-oriented surfaces—Neo ('provisions, governs, and optimizes your cloud infrastructure' via plain English) and an MCP server letting AI assistants query/search Pulumi Cloud stacks and resources and generate code—suggesting some AI-driven insight/suggestion capability. However, these are mostly vendor marketing claims with limited independent validation, and community feedback specifically criticizes Pulumi's genAI-based documentation/assistant quality as poor compared to competitors.
